svg.title: Stack push and pop trace diagram
svg.desc: Step-by-step stack operations showing push 5, push 10, push 3, pop, push 7, pop, pop
svg.text: Key rule: LIFO — Last In, First Out. Stack grows upward. TOP always points to last inserted element.
Final stack state: [5, 10] — 10 is on top. Operations: Push=O(1), Pop=O(1)
